profile.headline: Technical Support Software at Siemens Healthineers
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 13 years experience in the Healthcare IT  field, dedicated to fulfilling customers’ needs for fighting cancer. Expertise in HL7 standards, relational databases, virtualization with broad experience in programming.

positions.title: Technical Support Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed dozens of internal tools and microservices, directly improving workflows for technical helpdesk teams and supporting hundreds of users across the organization.
• Built and deployed solutions leveraging Azure DevOps, Azure App Service, Cosmos DB, Node.js, C# .NET 9, .NET Core, TypeScript, MongoDB, and MS SQL Server, with front-end development in React and desktop application development in WPF, ensuring scalable and maintainable architecture.
• Engineered automation solutions that reduced case processing time by up to 80%, significantly increasing team throughput and operational efficiency.
• Built and maintained scalable RESTful microservices and full-stack applications, streamlining complex support processes and eliminating manual, time-intensive tasks.
• Drove continuous improvement across internal systems by translating helpdesk pain points into well-architected software solutions with measurable impact.
• Collaborated cross-functionally to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver tools that enhanced responsiveness and reduced resolution time across support operations.

positions.title: Interface Analyst
positions.description:
• Coordinating and implementing HL7 developments at leading hospitals in North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
• Automated processes to resolve business challenges, such as data conversion, data mapping and Cloverleaf integrations, saving an estimated $7M annually.
• Building interfaces in major hospital information systems including, but not limited to, Epic, Cerner, Orchard, Soarian, Meditech, Paragon, Centricity, Rhapsody, LabCorp, Quest, and Harvest.
• Configuring and Maintaining full range of HL7 feeds: ADT, DFT, SIU, MDM, ORM and ORU
• Providing technical guidance and recommendations to ensure customer interface requirements are successfully accomplished as part of product implementation.
• Regularly support luminary customers.
• Wrote and edited technical documents, including interface specifications, user manuals, white papers, and tutorials.
• Serving as primary point of contact for customer during interface implementation/development.
• Designed dozens of software solutions driving continuous improvement to internal processes, systems, work  flow and customer responsiveness.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Installed Varian Oncology so ware products and system solutions in North America [U.S.A and Canada]
• Assisted service and sales managers in start-up of new products in the  eld (pre-release input, preparation and roll-out).
• Supported luminary customers.
• Mentored juniors engineers.
• Provided high level internal 2nd  er remote and onsite support to the field on Varian Oncology software products and system solutions.
• Established system support best practices like procedures to improve customer satisfaction during upgrades.
• Developed scripting tools to improve remote installations and network administration.
• Worked collaboratively with  field engineers, service, project and software managers to accomplish demanding deadlines.
• Provided acceptance test procedures, commissioning and handovers of systems to the customers.
• Trained other technicians, medical physicists, therapists and other customer representatives on relevant aspects of Varian’s Oncology software Products, troubleshooting, and documentation.
